RWA.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is mentioned.
The AI is in the health sector's community system, not general administration.

facts.fact: Rwanda Biomedical Centre says it has launched a project, funded by Expertise France, to enhance the community Electronic Medical Record system with AI tools for early detection of health issues and to monitor community health worker performance.

RWA.note: The AI platform is for training community health workers and tools for the health record; no AI model, dataset or computing facility is named as built.
The cEMR is a community-health-worker system, a noted class, with no tier, site or coverage stated.
